title: Inductor burns out above its rated current

implements.text: The inductor latches burnt when the current through it passes twice its rated current

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history, ageing and leakage; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

parameterSources.note: own estimate for a small moulded choke, low confidence
no source; a choke saturates well before it overheats

validation.dataset: src/sim/analog/live-health.test.ts: a capacitor and an inductor in the live solver

operatingRange.evidence: twice the 0.05 A rating of the inductor descriptor

knownFailureCases: Saturation is not modelled, so the inductance does not fall as the current rises
